sourceNotes.referenceTitle: DC Jewelry Twinkle Duo Ring – Star & Square
sourceNotes.rawContent:
A stylish combo of star and square-shaped rings with sparkling CZ stones — perfect for stacking or wearing solo.
Highlights:
- Trendy 2-piece ring set
- Adjustable & lightweight
- Perfect for teens, girls & everyday glam
Details:
- Plating: Rosegold
- Material: Brass
- Stones: American Diamonds
Care:
Keep away from water & perfumes. Wipe gently after use
